info.title: Data Butler — Verified Facts and Verified Changes
info.summary: Official figures by key, each with its source, verified date, hash and signature; and what changed since a date.
info.description:
The current value of one official figure by key — a tax threshold, rate, allowance, fee, deadline, limit or policy rate — with the date it was verified, the official source URL, the period it applies to and a signature. Keys are `<country>/<topic>/<fact>`, e.g. `uk/income-tax/personal-allowance`, `uk/national-insurance/primary-threshold`, `us/social-security/wage-base`, `de/income-tax/grundfreibetrag`, `uk/bank-rate`, `eu/ecb/deposit-facility`, `uk/gov/passport-renewal-adult/fee-online-uk`. A loose key is resolved when unambiguous; otherwise the answer lists candidate keys. `max_age` (e.g. `30d`) marks the answer `stale` when the verification is older than that. Several keys separated by commas return a batch. Covers UK, US and German rates and thresholds, UK vehicle tax and MOT rules, UK government service fees, UK exam dates and central-bank policy rates; `coverage` lists the rest.

Specification: https://databutler.dev/protocol/facts. No authentication.

license.name: Free to reuse with attribution to databutler.dev; each figure stays under its official source's terms

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: one key, or several separated by commas (max 50), e.g. uk/income-tax/personal-allowance

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: optional YYYY-MM-DD: the value in force that day

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: optional period label instead of as_of, e.g. 2025-26

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default) | txt (one line) | html (the indexable page)

200.description: The fact record (spec §4); a period not held answers covered:false with periodsHeld

404.description: Unknown key: candidates and the index URL (spec §5.4); not cached

get.description: A batch of up to 50 keys, results in request order; a miss inside the batch does not fail it (spec §7). Without keys, the index of every key (spec §5.5). POST /f with {"keys": [...]} is the same batch.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: comma-separated keys (max 50); omit for the index

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: optional YYYY-MM-DD: the value in force that day

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: optional period label instead of as_of, e.g. 2025-26

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: index only: one namespace (uk, us, de, eu)

200.description: A batch (with keys) or the index (without)

400.description: Too many keys or a bad option

get.summary: Find the key for a fact
get.description: Ranked canonical fact keys for a plain-language question or a guessed key — "NI primary threshold", "ECB deposit rate", "passport renewal fee" — each with label, unit, period and verification date, and the full record of the top match when it is unambiguous. The keys feed `get_fact`. Filter by `namespace` (`uk`, `us`, `de`, `eu`).

200.description: Ranked candidates, with best when unambiguous (spec §6)

get.description: What has changed in Data Butler's verified datasets since a date — pass your training-cutoff date to learn which UK tax/NI/benefit thresholds, exam-spec facts, official vehicle datasets (UK DVSA, French RappelConso and Japanese MLIT recalls), software end-of-life dates (Node.js, Python, Ubuntu, Debian, Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, PostgreSQL, React — cycles that reached end of life or whose dates moved), central-bank policy rates (Bank of England, Fed, ECB), US federal tax thresholds (IRS inflation adjustments, Social Security wage base, retirement and HSA limits), German tax and social-insurance thresholds (Grundfreibetrag, Beitragsbemessungsgrenzen, Zusatzbeitrag, Mindestlohn, Kindergeld), UK vehicle tax (VED) rates and MOT rules, UK exam dates (results days, summer timetable paper dates, entry deadlines and late-fee dates, announced specification changes), calendar facts (public holidays for the UK, US, Germany and France; tax-year and daylight-saving rules for nine countries — new years published, holidays added or moved), UK government service fees and rules (passports, ETA, Universal Credit, eVisa), Japanese vehicle statutory costs (車検 inspection fees, 自賠責 insurance rates) and Japanese minimum wages by prefecture, 協会けんぽ health insurance rates, 雇用保険料率 and income-tax deductions changed after your knowledge ends. Each entry: from → to, effectiveFrom, official source, verifiedDate, and a maintainer note (e.g. which Budget). Areas: uk-rates, uk-exams, vehicles, software-eol, policy-rates, us-rates, de-rates, uk-vehicle-rules, uk-exam-dates, calendar, uk-gov-process, jp-vehicle-costs, jp-living-costs, or all. Coverage starts 2026-08-31. The same changelog is published for humans at https://databutler.dev/changes, with feeds at https://databutler.dev/changes.rss and https://databutler.dev/changes.atom. Output is a Verified Changes protocol document (verified-changes/0.1, spec https://databutler.dev/protocol); an entry whose figure is a Verified Fact carries factKey for get_fact.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. your training cutoff

200.description: A Verified Changes document (verified-changes/0.1); entries carry factKey
